name: cts-talent-readiness
description: CTS Talent Readiness learning monorepo: UI library, SDK and Expo mobile app

scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace @cts-talent/sdk && npm run test:coverage --workspace @cts-talent/ui && npm run test:coverage --workspace talent-mobile
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cts-talent/sdk && npm run build --workspace @cts-talent/ui
scripts.pack:libs: npm run build && npm pack --workspace @cts-talent/sdk && npm pack --workspace @cts-talent/ui
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm test --workspace talent-readiness-dummy-api
